Even though it was my first time, they treated me with courtesy, the doctor's explanations were easy to understand, and they were also able to deal with small animals, which was very helpful.

Responsive and high quality service at a reasonable price. We felt reinsured to trust our dog to professionals who are competent and kind. Our dog needed teeth chirurgie and everything was fast and accurate. Other clinics overestimated the price and asked for scheduling the intervention many weeks in advance.

It's clean and spacious, but I haven't heard many good things about it.

It might be okay if you're just getting vaccinations or flea/tick medication.
I used their grooming service. It was very good. I would like to use it again.

They provide very courteous service!

Including their knowledge and excellent service, this is a very trustworthy animal hospital where I can entrust my pet with peace of mind.

The receptionist, in particular, is very friendly, as she also owns a Chihuahua, and we exchange information and she even tells me about good places to go! On top of that, she's always very helpful and I appreciate that we can talk about anything with genuine care!

They have many high-quality products available for purchase, and I always order from them.

Thank you as always 😊

I use their grooming services.

This area has several animal hospitals, pet hotels, and pet salons within walking distance, and I initially visited all of them, but I finally settled on this one.

It's not a large hospital, but the doctor listens carefully, and they notice any changes in my pet's condition when I leave them there and suggest treatment options, which is very helpful. The staff are all very kind.

I still go to the hospital I've been using since before we moved for vaccinations, but for minor ailments, Foresta Animal Hospital is a reassuring veterinarian to have within walking distance.

I always bring my parakeet here for checkups.

There aren't many places in Tokyo that treat birds, so I'm grateful just to have this clinic.

They always examine my parakeet very carefully.

When trimming its claws or feathers, the nurses gently reassure it, saying "It's okay," and when I brought it in when it wasn't feeling well, they took the time to explain everything very thoroughly.

They also keep very detailed medical records, which I really appreciate.

I'm truly grateful, thank you so much!
